    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All three matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative float, not a boolean")
    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative and finite")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted negative log probability losses (T02)
    def weighted_loss(logp: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return - (logp @ normalized_weights)

    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    keep = margin >= tau_filter
